mission.title: Murder Mystery
mission.description: Investigate the scene of three tidily executed killings.

phase.briefing: A cluster of tidily-executed human bodies has been found in the City. We suspect that this is the work of something more dangerous than a mere serial killer. Investigate the crime scene and look for clues regarding this new, unknown threat.

enter.say: You will find the three bodies in that building, operative. Investigate the site.
Ah, two members of the local constabulary. Tell them both that you are on a special mission. You may use my name.

done.say: Obviously there has been some... miscommunication in the local constabulary. I will have to take care of that... personally. In the meantime, operative, deal with these two oafs as you see fit.
Here are the bodies that were reported. Man--they look like powerful fighters, but they all died from a single bullet to the middle of the forehead.

That is a curious crime scene, but it raises more questions than it answers. Fortunately, we have located a witness who was scared off by the blundering law enforcement officials. Go outside and you will receive a waypoint to her location.
Good help is rather hard to find these days. I shall have to have words with their Captain.

phase.briefing: A waypoint indicating the witness' location is uploading to you now. Find the witness and question her about what she saw at the crime scene. See if you can find out what sort of entity it was that struck down three powerful fighters so easily.

enter.say: A witness to the shooting, Jazmin Quint, is in that building. I guess she was frightened and fled the scene, but she called in after she calmed down. Talk to her and find out what she saw.
There's the witness. Interview her and find out what she saw.

talk.say: Oh, you're the special investigator they told me about? Well, I didn't see the actual shooting, but I think I got there right after it happened. The door was open and the room was full of flies--which was kind of odd, come to think of it.

done.say: Hm. I am not sure how relevant her observation is. You may as well leave, op-- Hello, it appears that our misguided security force has surrounded your location. Well, do what you must to get out.

mission.finish: Our apologies for the... confusion among our security forces, {player}. We will be dealing with that swiftly. In any case, thank you for your investigations into the shooting. Our intelligence network will begin sifting these clues for leads. It is certainly remarkable that three powerful Zion operatives were terminated in such an efficient manner.
